name: @bdocs/zig-critters
description: Critical CSS extraction engine written in Zig, compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.build:wasm: cd zig && rm -rf .zig-cache && zig build -Dtarget=wasm32-wasi -Doptimize=ReleaseFast && mkdir -p zig-out/bin && find .zig-cache -name 'zig-critters.wasm' -exec cp {} zig-out/bin/zig-critters.wasm \;
scripts.build: zig --version >/dev/null 2>&1 && pnpm run build:wasm || echo 'Zig not installed, skipping build'
